 Bench At Aurangabad

sentences.text:
Advocate for Petitioner : J. M. Murkute
 Agp for Respondent/State : Mr. A.S. Shinde

Coram : Mangesh S. Patil &
 S. G. Chapalgaonkar, Jj.

PER COURT :
Heard learned advocate for the petitioner and the learned A.G.P. for the respondents/State.
2. The petitioner's property being Survey No. 451 admeasuring 0- Hectare 30 Are and Survey No.
452 admeasuring 0 Hectare 69-Are situated at Gangakhed Tq. Gangakhed Dist. Parbhani were reserved for 'children park' in development plan of the respondent No. 4.

Since no steps were taken as contemplated under the Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act (M.R.T.P. Act) read with relevant provisions of the Land Acquisition Act for a period of 10 years, a notice under Section 127 of the M.R.T.P. act was issued on 26.12.2017 and on failure to take the steps in next two years the petition has been filed.

entities.text: Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act (M.R.T.P. Act)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned A.G.P. on the basis of the reply filed submits that they have not received any proposal from the respondent No. 4-Municipal Council for acquisition of petitioner's properties for utilizing the reservation.
4. The respondent No. 4's reply clearly demonstrates that for want of 50 WP 2714 OF 2021.odt funds it is not in a position to undertake the acquisition.

When admittedly, no steps have been taken as is contemplated under Section 126(4) read with Section 6 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or Section 19 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 within the stipulated time, the consequences would be axiomatic as laid down in the matter of M/s. Girnar Traders vs State Of Maharashtra & Ors; A.I.R. 2007 SC 3184.
6.

sentences.text: It is declared that the reservation on the petitioner's properties (Survey No. 451 admeasuring 0-Hectare 30 Are and Survey No. 452 admeasuring 0 Hectare 69-Are situated at Gangakhed Tq. Gangakhed Dist. Parbhani) stands lapsed.
7. The respondents shall take immediate steps for issuance of notification under sub Section 2 of Section 127 of the M.R.T.P. Act.

( S. G. CHAPALGAONKAR, J.) (MANGESH S. PATIL, J.) mkd/-
